deploy-bot: Started deploy to prod · env=us-east-1 · user=@maria.l · release_tag=v2.8.1 · launcher=release-orch
deploy-bot: Commits included:
```
- 4f3b2a9 - PR #4123 by @devon - fix: reduce KV cache pressure (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/commit/4f3b2a9)
- a7c9e10 - PR #4140 by @simon - perf: optimize attention kernel selection (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/commit/a7c9e10)
- d1e6b88 - PR #4137 by @maria.l - ops: bump rollout defaults for canary (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/orch/commit/d1e6b88)
```

deploy-bot: Canaries: 5% traffic (3 instances) · expected duration ~7m · change-window=2026-03-20T02:00Z
devon: noted, watching logs · will ping if any error spikes
simon: added link to the perf benchmarks in PR #4140: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4140 · looks good on local perf tests :+1:
oncall-bot: Alert channel set to #eng-oncall for any error-rate > 0.5% during canary
maria.l: FYI — pinned model-serving image to sha: bb2c9f1 for stability (see artifact: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/images/bb2c9f1)
simon: quick sanity check — are we retaining previous variant for fallback?
maria.l: yes, fallback policy=previous-tag · automatic switch if 5xx > 1% for 2 consecutive minutes
simon: ok, good
deploy-bot: Canary finished · status=ok · promoted to 50% traffic · commit_range=bb2c9f1..4f3b2a9
devon: I'm seeing a small increase in latency p50 from 120ms -> 150ms on session-prime tests, digging in
iris: looking at tracing — KV cache miss rate spiked on a small subset of requests, pattern matches PR #4123 change
devon: reducing canary to 20% while we validate, rolling back to previous variant if we hit >2% error or latency p95 > 900ms
maria.l: ack, initiating partial rollback plan if threshold hit. Leaving canary at 20% for now
deploy-bot: Rollback prepared · target_tag=v2.8.0 · rollback_shas=[c9a1f00] · reason=auto-threshold not yet met
deploy-bot: Deployment resumed to 20% · status=paused-monitoring
oncall-bot: If rollback triggered, page @simon and @devon immediately
devon: found an edge case in batch keying causing extra cache misses, pushing hotfix PR #4151 (patch) — will request fast-track review
simon: please include test snippet for reproducer in PR, will review quick
maria.l: thanks team. if hotfix lands cleanly we can re-run canary from 0 -> 50% and shorten window. No full-prod rollback unless 5xx > 1% sustained
deploy-bot: Hotfix PR #4151 deployed to staging for smoke tests: commit bb9d1e2 · link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4151
devon: smoke looks good on staging, merging now
maria.l: merging and will coordinate re-run. schedule: re-canary start in ~10m
deploy-bot: Re-canary started · from_tag=v2.8.1-hotfix · to=prod · canary=5%
simon: monitoring logs and traces
iris: KV miss rate back to baseline in initial samples
devon: latency p50 back to 125ms, p95 stable under 700ms
maria.l: promoting to 50%
deploy-bot: Deploy finished · status=success · final_tag=v2.8.1+hotfix · merged_prs=[#4123,#4140,#4137,#4151] · authors=[devon,simon,maria.l] · release_notes=https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2.8.1
maria.l: Release notes updated, sending summary to #product and posting changelog. thanks all :tada:
simon: great work team
